verdict.rationale: Extend is a SaaS document-processing platform, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no bulk export of account data (processors, workflows, evaluation sets, run outputs) in open formats. Deletion APIs, retention controls and per-run API/CLI outputs are adjacent building blocks, not an export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
